steps.title: Configure Application Metadata
steps.description: Define app identifiers, metadata, package configuration, and permissions for PhotoForge Pro.

steps.title: Define Local Engine Schema
steps.description: Specify local deterministic business logic and offline adjustment calculations schema.

steps.title: Setup Manifest & Permissions
steps.description: Declare hardware acceleration, storage access, gallery pickers, and main studio activity.

steps.title: Create Dark Studio Palette & Styles
steps.description: Build high-contrast obsidian dark theme colors, slate accents, and professional slider assets.

steps.title: Design Interactive Studio Drawables
steps.description: Construct UI backgrounds, rounded badges, split view icons, and tool button selectors.

steps.title: Implement Native Image Processing Engine
steps.description: Build ImageProcessor with ColorMatrix pipelines, exposure/contrast formulas, and preset filters.

steps.title: Implement State & History Management
steps.description: Construct EditState and EditHistory stack supporting multi-level non-destructive undo/redo.

steps.title: Build Real-Time PhotoCanvasView
steps.description: Create custom high-performance Android View with real-time hardware-accelerated preview, EXIF overlay, and split Before/After curtain.

steps.title: Construct Studio Layout Architecture
steps.description: Assemble top header, tool ribbons, adjustment drawers, and bottom navigation bar in XML.

steps.title: Implement Studio UI Controller
steps.description: Bind interactive sliders, tool categories, image loader, export dialog, and split comparisons.

steps.title: Building PhotoForge Pro
steps.description: Compile debug APK using Gradle 8.5, Android SDK 34, and Temurin 17 toolchain.
